question: Should OpenClaw retire `coalesceSameSenderDms` now and require `imsg` 0.11.1 or newer, accepting doctor and binary-upgrade actions for existing users?
rationale: The patch converts previously accepted persisted config and older working binaries into fail-closed upgrade states; tests can establish mechanics, but only repository ownership can approve that compatibility policy.

options.title: Approve after delivery proof
options.body: Accept the hard floor and config retirement after exact-head macOS proof shows one-turn split-send delivery and actionable old-version recovery output.

options.title: Defer retirement
options.body: Keep the current option and OpenClaw fallback until maintainers are ready to require the config and dependency upgrade together.

recommendation.title: Approve after delivery proof
recommendation.body: Accept the hard floor and config retirement after exact-head macOS proof shows one-turn split-send delivery and actionable old-version recovery output.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved choice centers on the supported `imsg` release floor and operator upgrade policy, and this owner signed the dependency release establishing that boundary.
